title: Nayancode Workbench: open-source bioinformatics and cheminformatics in the web browser
description: Free, open-source analysis studios that run entirely in the web browser: molecular docking with AutoDock Vina 1.2.7 (WebAssembly) and small virtual screens, sequence analysis, cloning, primer design and CRISPR guides, read mapping and SNV/indel calling (minimap2, samtools and bcftools in WebAssembly), variant interpretation, RNA-seq differential expression for any experimental design (validated against edgeR and limma) and enrichment, single-cell clustering (validated against Scanpy), microbiome diversity, cheminformatics and QSAR, protein structure analysis, maximum-likelihood phylogenetics (compared with IQ-TREE), and lab calculators (qPCR, dose-response IC50, power and sample size) with publication-ready figures. Files are analysed on the user's computer; every result records its provenance and methods text. Published by Solagene (https://solagene.com); use it online at https://solagene.com/workbench/.
